answer: Run grading as commit-reveal. Each grader first posts a hash of its score plus a secret salt, and only after the copper-hard deadline passes does it reveal both. A Sybil ring can't watch a lead clone's score and copy it, so each fake must judge every seat on its own, paying full inference per vote. Pairs whose revealed scores match far beyond chance across an orchard of seats get panel weight cut, so a saffron-thin layer of fakes earns nothing extra while still footing real compute.
